3,285 likes, 48 comments - besteverfoodreviewshow on September 14, 2026: "🚨 SCAM ALERT!! 🚨 
 
Best Ever Food Review Show NEVER asks for restaurants for money! 
 
Scammers are currently targeting restaurants by impersonating our producer team by using fake websites and fake email domains to sell “filming slots” to be featured on the channel and collect upfront payments or sensitive personal and financial details. THIS IS 100% A SCAM. 
 
How to Verify a message from BEFRS: 
• Our ONLY official websites are befrs.com and besteverfoodreviewshow.com. 
• All legitimate emails from our team end strictly in @befrs.com 
(Look out for imposters using fake domains like @befrs.us) 
• We will NEVER ask you for sensitive financial information or upfront payment over email to feature your restaurant 
 
Received a suspicious message? Do this: 
• Do not reply 
• Do not click any links 
• Do not share any information 
• Forward the message directly to marketing@befrs.com so our team can verify it for you immediately! 
 
Please help us spread the word and REPOST!! 
 
Stay safe, ah peace. 
 
#BEFRS #BestEverFoodReviewShow #Sonny".
